notes.title: Game patch v1.1.0
notes.content:
Hello everyone 👋!

I have released the last content update for the game that includes the new biome, some QoL features and some bug solving.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45340247/f320106443552aa00184fb7f61f56e0faaf7329e.png[/img]

Here you have all the changes:

[h3]New:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added a new colorful forest biome.
[*] Added a new npc located in the new biome and its achievement.
[*] Added achievement for Plinat.
[*] 3 "Seasonal" npcs that will appear during Christmas (24 December to 6 January), Halloween (31 October and 1 November) and Valentine's day (14 February) on different biomes. These don't have achievements.
[/list]

[h3]QoL features:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added a digital clock under the minimap.
[*] Intro can be skipped now.
[*] You now start with a random Dipets instead of always the same.
[*] Added hints for INT required in Dipet skill menu and combat.
[*] Your dipet will stay still when using the defend command.
[*] Reduced skill cooldowns in combat to make battles faster.
[*] Dipet won't change skills when evolving (unless the new evolution has a different Type).
[*] Increased default fps limit to 240 (you can still change it in config menu).
[/list]

[h3]Bugs solved:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that made the resolution to not load correctly.
[*] Changed method of getting screen dimensions for resolution (previous one didn't work properly for some people).
[*] Fixed a bug that made the game crash when trying to interact with the training attack sign.
[*] Fixed some typos in conversations (let me know if you find more please).
[/list]


As I commented in the last post, I have lost motivation after seeing many people saying that the game is not fun and that there is practically zero interest in the game.  I will keep making games in my free time (probably not as much as I have now) and uploading them to [url=https://kiriboo.itch.io/]Itch.io: https://kiriboo.itch.io/[/url] until I have a new cool idea and some interest in it.
I really appreciate the small community and content creators who took a bit of time to support me and the game.

If you have any problems or want to give some feedback about the game, let me know through my social media, I'm always open for suggestions:

[url=https://x.com/Kiriboo93]X[/url] ✦ [url=https://bsky.app/profile/kiriboo.bsky.social]Bluesky[/url]

 Or the game social media:

[url=https://x.com/DipetsGame]X[/url] ✦ [url=https://bsky.app/profile/dipets.bsky.social]Bluesky[/url]

Thank you everyone,
Roberto.

notes.title: Game patch v1.0.1
notes.content:
Hello everyone! 
I have updated the game and demo with a new patch fixing some problematic things the game had:

[list]
[*] Increased a bit the starting hp and mp of your dipet.
[*] Training events in the gym should not show the question twice now.
[*] If your dipet tries to attack without mana, a "No mana" message will appear.
[*] Your dipet should now ask for food and go to the bathroom less often.
[*] Added a small scene to show when there is a new building in the city.
[*] You now shouldn't be able to play the game on a resolution higher than the one on your screen.
[*] Fixed some minor visual bugs.
[/list]

That's all for now. I will start working on the next patch that should fix some other things (I want to add the save option in the menu so you don't only save when sleeping or with the autosave, for example).

notes.title: Dipets release and what's to come!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Dipets is releasing today!
I hope you all have fun recruiting all the npcs that are right now in the game, fighting the bosses, completing the story or just growing your dipets stronger!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45340247/54e7ee6102919844c23f512b190d28b0115565c7.gif[/img]

And after the release, some of you may be asking what's next so here it is:
[list]
[*] I will continue updating the game with at least a couple more biomes that I have in mind.
[*] I will add some npcs to fix some of the weaknesses the game has right now (explaining things a bit more).
[*] I will add different events that some of you suggested through feedback (when you come back to the town and a new building has been unlocked for example).
[*] I will add a new feature unlocked through one of those npcs that can add a bit more content.
[*] And finally, I'm starting to develop a new project related to Dipets and consists on one of the Dipets running across your Desktop with some of the same features of Dipets (mostly the tamagotchi part of it).
[/list]

On a personal level, I'm super nervous wondering if you are going to enjoy the game or if you will find any [strike]bug[/strike] feature that I missed ːsteamfacepalmː! (If you do, please contact me as soon as possible to fix it!).

I don't want to keep you reading any longer, so let yourselves be absorbed by the game and take care of your dipets!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45340247/ece901aac17ed9ea463948195a5611a74875736a.gif[/img]



If you have any problems or want to give some feedback about the game, let me know through my social media: 

[url=https://x.com/Kiriboo93]X[/url] ✦ [url=https://bsky.app/profile/kiriboo.bsky.social]Bluesky[/url] ✦ [url=https://discord.gg/nUFdqPEYRD]Discord[/url]

 Or the game social media:

[url=https://x.com/DipetsGame]X[/url] ✦ [url=https://bsky.app/profile/dipets.bsky.social]Bluesky[/url] ✦ [url=support@dipets.net]support@dipets.net[/url]

Thank you for everything, you guys rock!

notes.title: Demo update v1.0.3
notes.content:
Hello everyone! I have updated the demo with a new patch fixing some problematic things that you found while playing the demo during SteamNextFest:

[list]
[*] Increased the sensitivity of joystick on controllers. They should feel a bit better now! (You still need to have it plugged in before starting the game) 🎮.
[*] Decreased a bit enemy difficulty (because a lot of you are dieing a lot 😅).
[*] Increased a bit defense buff duration and the amount of damage it mitigates 🛡️.
[*] Healing items (HP and MP) can be used out of combat now! 💉
[*] If you have not unlocked the shop, Cakin will give you new healing items if you run out of them! 💰
[*] Fixed some minor visual bugs. 🐞
[/list]


If you have any more problems or want to give some feedback, let me know through my social media:

 [url=https://x.com/Kiriboo93]X[/url] ✦ [url=https://bsky.app/profile/kiriboo.bsky.social]Bluesky[/url]

Or the game social media:

[url=https://x.com/DipetsGame]X[/url] ✦ [url=https://bsky.app/profile/dipets.bsky.social]Bluesky[/url] ✦ support@dipets.net


Thank you for playing, remember to wishlist and I hope you all are having fun playing all the awesome demos!
